title: Body of missing teen found in D4vd’s Tesla likely ‘dead for several weeks,’ says police
summary: Celeste Rivas Hernandez, first reported missing at age 13, found decomposing in trunk of singer’s car in Los Angeles The missing teenager whose body was discovered decomposing in singer D4vd’s Tesla in early September likely died several weeks earlier, according to the Los Angeles police department. Celeste Rivas Hernandez was found dead in the trunk of the singer’s car on 8 September, one day after her 15th birthday, following reports of a foul odor emanating from the vehicle. The then 13-year-old Rivas Hernandez was first reported missing on 5 April 2024. Continue reading...
